distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Amasa concitata from Jiangxi and Taiwan. Lin et al. (2024) adds Guangdong as a new provincial record from the Dinghu Mountains, Zhaoqing. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documents the earlier Taiwan occurrence.
distribution.evidence: Integrated source records SmithEtAl2020_001, LinEtAl2024_AmasaYunnan_003 and BeaverLiu2010_TaiwanScolytinae_069.

host_note: No confirmed host taxon is currently promoted. Source wording such as “Formosan hardwood” and “angiosperm wood” remains source-level context rather than a standardized host assignment.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Amasa concitata Schedl, 1969. The integrated backbone also retains Xyleborus concitata Schedl, 1969 as the original combination / basionym.

taxonomic_history.name: Amasa concitata
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted combination in Smith et al. (2020) and the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The Smith et al. (2020) China record maps directly to VSN_0159 and does not introduce a nomenclatural change in the current synthesis.

resources.images: No image records are linked yet.
resources.specimens: A locality record from Jiulianshan, Longnan County, Jiangxi is documented in the integrated source evidence; dedicated specimen records are not yet linked.
